name: STIHL MS 181 C-BE
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ PICCO Micro Mini 3, .043″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links, from STIHL's 2025 chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 181 C-BE is in the same 2025 chart block as the MS 170 and MS 171. STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart (catalog p. 166) puts this saw in one block with the MS 170, MS 180 and MS 180 C-BE. The block is 3/8″ PICCO Micro Mini 3, .043″ gauge: 61 PMM3 44 on a 12″ bar (3005 008 3905), 61 PMM3 50 on 14″ (3005 008 3909) and 61 PMM3 55 on 16″ (3005 008 3913). STIHL's file table lists 5/32″ (4.0 mm) for 3/8″ PICCO. The same three loops are on the MS 170 / MS 180 page, which also records Oregon's 11/64″ file for the .043″ low-profile equivalent.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 61 PMM3 44 with recommended bar 3005 008 3905. The block header names the MS 170, MS 171, MS 180, MS 180 C-BE and MS 181 C-BE together. 3/8″ PICCO Micro Mini 3, .043″ gauge, 12″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 61 PMM3 50 with recommended bar 3005 008 3909. The block header names the MS 170, MS 171, MS 180, MS 180 C-BE and MS 181 C-BE together. 3/8″ PICCO Micro Mini 3, .043″ gauge, 14″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

STIHL's 2025 drive-link chart lists chain 61 PMM3 55 with recommended bar 3005 008 3913. The block header names the MS 170, MS 171, MS 180, MS 180 C-BE and MS 181 C-BE together. 3/8″ PICCO Micro Mini 3, .043″ gauge, 16″ bar. STIHL's file table lists a 5/32″ (4.0 mm) file for 3/8″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: specification tables (catalog pp. 64–67, specifications as of 1 October 2024) and the guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog pp. 166–167), including the file table and the PMM3/PM3 chain-type rows

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, guide-bar drive-link chart (catalog p. 166), MS 170 / MS 171 / MS 180 / MS 181 C-BE block, read 7 Nov 2026. File size from that catalog's file table: 5/32″ for 3/8″ PICCO.
